_comment: Sample project-scope MCP config for Claude Code (save as .mcp.json in
the directory you run `claude` from). Replace the two placeholders
before use — they are NOT expanded automatically:
${SVF_REPO}        absolute path to your SVF-xiao checkout
Remove this _comment key if your tooling objects to unknown keys.
Codex uses .codex/config.toml instead; this checkout has one at repo root.
See docs/tutorials/06-claude-code-mcp.md for the full walkthrough.
